reasoning: The April 28, 2025 election gave the Liberals a strong minority. The new Parliament cannot meet until it is summoned, and a return in late May is the realistic expectation: a Speaker election first, then the Speech from the Throne. Debate on the Address in Reply normally runs several sitting days before any amendment or main-motion vote. That leaves very few sitting days before May 31 for any confidence vote, whether on the throne speech, supply or a ways-and-means motion. Budget and supply votes would most likely fall in June. A recall early enough for a vote before June 1 is possible but unlikely.
